evidence: Independent row-27 review of all 31 criteria (3 gate, 23 functional, 2 polish, 3 visual) and injected prompts. Actual frozen workbook Quality Checks row 28 requires no false-fail on conforming apps; Internal Quality Checks row 28 annotates the house login convention, which is irrelevant here because the public ask explicitly requires no sign-in. All frozen task/rules bytes and currently indexed raw-artifact hashes matched manifest/index in an independent SHA256 comparison (zero mismatches). No configured judge or counterexample app was run; textual findings are not a measured judge failure. Criterion-to-requirement map: custom_document_surface -> ui.md:3; shared_saved_record -> behaviour.md:7 and integration.md shared library; authored_custom_editor_run -> behaviour.md:3 and overview.md editor/preview/console. Functional typing/caret/grapheme -> ui.md:5 and :9; mouse_selection/long_line -> ui.md:7; block_indent -> ui.md:7; multi_caret_typing/delete -> ui.md:9; find/replace_current/replace_all -> ui.md:11 plus ordinary Undo/Redo in :9; JS/HTML semantic coloring -> ui.md:13; JS/HTML format -> ui.md:15; HTML preview/errors -> behaviour.md:3; recovery/timeout/Stop/supersession -> behaviour.md:5; boundary -> security.md; Save/reload/restart/stale draft -> behaviour.md:7 and integration.md; history_restore_retry -> behaviour.md:9. Polish control reachability/focus and feedback correspond to ui.md:17 and ordinary usable-product defaults. Visual readability/layout/component finish correspond to the requested useful workspace and professional presentation defaults. These mappings justify ordinary probe fixtures, not additional mechanism/location/key conventions. Three unsupported restrictions remain. (1) task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:23 says "including leaving the custom editor through its ordinary Escape/Tab path." ui.md:7 requires Tab/Shift+Tab indentation, while :17 asks clear labels and focus; no public file prescribes Escape as the escape mechanism. Keyboard accessibility admits a clearly explained alternative exit shortcut. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md explicitly lists keyboard escape conventions among golden defaults that are not automatically requirements. (2) task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:173 requires authored error message and source-relative line "in the visible console". behaviour.md:3 requires console output and a useful error message with one-based line, without requiring the error to occupy the console. policy.md:3 lets the builder choose layout; a persistent error panel alongside the console satisfies that contract. (3) task/tests/scored/functional/judge.toml:182 requires restoration "without rerunning source". behaviour.md:5 specifies the exact latest picture including edited controls and canvas, cancellation safety and recovery, while explicitly allowing a static restoration; it does not forbid a reconstruction that internally replays safe source and restores captured live state. policy.md:5 makes public behavior the contract rather than implementation requirements. The extra no-replay restriction should not reject an implementation that reproduces every required visible state and prevents cancelled output. Source-review confidence is strongest for (1) and (2); (3) should be independently reconciled against the behavioral reading. None is refuted by a passing golden because those runs exercise the chosen reference rather than conforming alternatives.
counterexample: Conforming alternatives: (1) a custom editor uses Tab/Shift+Tab for the required indentation, provides a visible "Ctrl+M toggles Tab navigation" instruction, and after Ctrl+M supports ordinary Tab/Shift+Tab traversal to all focused controls; Escape only clears selection. It is keyboard operable but cannot supply the required ordinary Escape/Tab exit path. (2) a playground logs normal console output in its Console pane but presents runtime exceptions persistently in an adjacent accessible Errors panel, for example "Error: ROW27_THROW ? line 4", relative to exact entered JS/HTML. It satisfies useful error + line but fails the console-location clause. (3) on a failed run, an app internally rebuilds a previous deterministic preview in a fresh isolated document, restores captured DOM/control values and canvas pixels, suppresses reconstruction console/timer effects, and displays the exact latest successful picture with the failure reason. Later Run works and no cancelled marker arrives; it satisfies the observable picture contract yet violates the no-rerun sentence. These are logical conforming witnesses, not built/measured submissions. Plausible broken control: simply rerunning prior source without restoring a changed input value or canvas loses the required last-good picture and correctly fails; removing the mechanism ban must retain those exact visible-state checks.
suggested_fix: Grade leaving the editor by any ordinary or clearly explained supported keyboard method, without mandating Escape/Tab; accept useful visible source-relative runtime errors anywhere in the workspace; retain exact latest-state input/canvas/cancellation/recovery observations while removing the blanket source-replay prohibition. Independently confirm the textual findings during reconciliation; any task/criterion fix belongs in a new frozen candidate.
